prompts.name: kk_imsg_taxi_photo
prompts.prompt: The attached image is an iPhone Messages screenshot in dark mode with the Korean keyboard open. Create a REAL amateur photo of an iPhone whose screen shows exactly this screenshot, taken in a dark room with another phone. The phone screen fills almost the entire frame, slightly tilted about 8 degrees and seen slightly from the left, the top-left and right edges of the screen are cut off by the frame, a thin black phone bezel visible on the left side. Keep every bubble, every Korean word, the numbers, the avatar, the input bar and the keyboard exactly as in the screenshot; do not add, remove or repeat anything. Real photo artifacts: subtle screen moire pattern, slightly soft focus, faint reflection of a ceiling light on the glass, a few dust specks, phone camera noise, the screen glow being the main light source. No other text, no watermark.
